name: RoboOrchard Core v0.7.0-release
body:
# RoboOrchard Core v0.7.0-release

RoboOrchard Core 0.7.0 introduces a lightweight base installation for common configuration and CLI use while keeping the robotics runtime available through explicit extras and preserving compatibility for existing robotics consumers.

## What's Changed

### New Features

#### Installation & Dependency Profiles

- Introduce a slim base install that avoids the deep-learning, vision, environment, and kinematics stack while retaining common configuration and CLI dependencies. (commit f760a53f851c00dbde55a081dd2976f031911ec1)
- Add the `robotics` extra for the complete robotics stack and retain `all` as the aggregate of official extras. (commit f760a53f851c00dbde55a081dd2976f031911ec1)

#### Configuration & Datatypes

- Preserve `TorchTensor` and `NumpyTensor` as lazy public aliases when optional backends are available, with actionable missing-extra errors otherwise. (commit f760a53f851c00dbde55a081dd2976f031911ec1)

### Improvements

#### CLI & Runtime

- Keep Typer and pydantic-settings in the base dependency closure and make core imports and CLI help predictable when optional robotics dependencies are absent. (commit f760a53f851c00dbde55a081dd2976f031911ec1)

#### Documentation & Developer Guidance

- Document the base, `robotics`, and `all` installation paths and add installed-wheel coverage for the slim profile. (commit f760a53f851c00dbde55a081dd2976f031911ec1)

### Compatibility

#### Versioning & Dependencies

- Advance the package version to 0.7.0 and pin Sphinx AutoAPI to 3.8.0 for reproducible documentation builds. (commits 9aa684068d7a405c1b1614c351c82d0ce7c483ba, f760a53f851c00dbde55a081dd2976f031911ec1)
- Retain `kinematic` as a compatibility alias for `robotics`; existing users can continue using that selector. (commit f760a53f851c00dbde55a081dd2976f031911ec1)

### Migration Guide

#### Installation

- Users that need the robotics runtime should install `robo_orchard_core[robotics]`; the historical `robo_orchard_core[kinematic]` selector remains supported. (commit f760a53f851c00dbde55a081dd2976f031911ec1)
